description: This file defines a Java interface 'RunReportsApi' for interacting with the Fineract reporting API via Feign client. It includes methods to run reports and retrieve report files, with detailed documentation and annotations.

classes.name: RunReportsApi
classes.description: Java interface for Fineract report API, providing methods to execute reports and fetch report files.

methods.name: runReportGetData
methods.description: Executes a report and returns the report data as a RunReportsResponse object.

methods.name: runReportGetFile
methods.description: Executes a report and returns the report output as a file response (PDF, CSV, XLS, etc.).
